package onboardingpathexecution

)

func TestLessonCheckpointCrashResumesOnlyMissingPrompt(t *testing.T) {
	for crashAfter := 0; crashAfter < 2; crashAfter++ {
		t.Run(string(rune('A'+crashAfter)), func(t *testing.T) {
			frozen := checkpointFrozen(t)
			repo := &checkpointRepo{crashAfter: crashAfter}
			generator := &checkpointGenerator{}
			now := time.Date(2026, 9, 11, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
			execution := domain.OnboardingPathExecution{ExecutionID: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333", ClaimToken: "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444", AdmissionID: "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555", AdmissionFence: 1, Handoff: checkpointHandoff(now)}
			processor := Processor{Executions: repo, Generator: generator, Students: checkpointStudent{}, Clock: checkpointClock{now}, LeaseTTL: time.Minute}
			if _, err := processor.generateCheckpointedCourse(context.Background(), &execution, frozen); err == nil {
				t.Fatal("expected simulated post-checkpoint crash")
			}
			before := generator.calls
			repo.crashAfter = -1
			course, err := processor.generateCheckpointedCourse(context.Background(), &execution, frozen)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if len(repo.contents) != 2 || generator.calls-before != 2-(crashAfter+1) {
				t.Fatalf("calls=%d before=%d stored=%d", generator.calls, before, len(repo.contents))
			}
			if course.Status != domain.CourseStatusActive {
				t.Fatalf("course status=%s", course.Status)
			}
		})
	}
}

type checkpointRepo struct {
	contents   []domain.OnboardingPathLessonContent
	crashAfter int
}

func (r *checkpointRepo) NextAcceptedHandoff(context.Context) (domain.OnboardingPlanHandoffRecord, error) {
	return domain.OnboardingPlanHandoffRecord{}, domain.ErrNotFound
}
func (r *checkpointRepo) NextOnboardingPathExecution(context.Context, time.Time) (domain.OnboardingPathExecution, error) {
	return domain.OnboardingPathExecution{}, domain.ErrNotFound
}
func (r *checkpointRepo) CreateOrGetOnboardingPathExecution(context.Context, domain.OnboardingPathExecution) (domain.OnboardingPathExecution, bool, error) {
	return domain.OnboardingPathExecution{}, false, errors.New("unused")
}
func (r *checkpointRepo) ClaimOnboardingPathExecution(context.Context, string, string, time.Time, time.Time) (domain.OnboardingPathExecution, error) {
	return domain.OnboardingPathExecution{}, errors.New("unused")
}
func (r *checkpointRepo) RenewOnboardingPathExecution(context.Context, string, string, int64, time.Time, time.Time, time.Time) error {
	return nil
}
func (r *checkpointRepo) CheckpointOnboardingSnapshot(context.Context, domain.OnboardingPathExecution, string, []byte, string, string, int64, time.Time, time.Time) error {
	return errors.New("unused")
}
func (r *checkpointRepo) CheckpointOnboardingCourse(context.Context, domain.OnboardingPathExecution, string, []byte, string, time.Time) error {
	return errors.New("unused")
}
func (r *checkpointRepo) CheckpointOnboardingCourseReceipt(context.Context, domain.OnboardingPathExecution, string, string, bool, []domain.CourseLessonBinding, time.Time) error {
	return errors.New("unused")
}
func (r *checkpointRepo) CheckpointOnboardingMaterialization(context.Context, domain.OnboardingPathExecution, string, string, time.Time) error {
	return errors.New("unused")
}
func (r *checkpointRepo) ListOnboardingPathLessonContent(context.Context, string) ([]domain.OnboardingPathLessonContent, error) {
	return append([]domain.OnboardingPathLessonContent(nil), r.contents...), nil
}
func (r *checkpointRepo) CheckpointOnboardingPathLessonContent(_ context.Context, _ domain.OnboardingPathExecution, _ string, item domain.OnboardingPathLessonContent) error {
	r.contents = append(r.contents, item)
	if item.LessonIndex == r.crashAfter {
		return errors.New("crash after durable lesson checkpoint")
	}
	return nil
}
func (r *checkpointRepo) CompleteOnboardingPathExecution(context.Context, domain.OnboardingPathExecution, string, time.Time) error {
	return errors.New("unused")
}
func (r *checkpointRepo) RetryOnboardingPathExecution(context.Context, domain.OnboardingPathExecution, string, string, time.Time, time.Time) error {
	return errors.New("unused")
}

var _ repository.OnboardingPathExecutionRepository = (*checkpointRepo)(nil)

type checkpointGenerator struct{ calls int }

func (g *checkpointGenerator) GenerateLesson(_ context.Context, _ domainservice.LessonGenerationInput, _ string) (domainservice.GeneratedLessonContent, error) {
	g.calls++
	return domainservice.GeneratedLessonContent{DescriptionMarkdown: "Description", Examples: []domain.PlannedExample{{Title: "Example", DescriptionMarkdown: "Example description", Stacks: []string{"go"}, TargetConcepts: []string{"concept"}}}, KnowledgeChecks: []domain.PlannedTask{{Title: "Check", DescriptionMarkdown: "Check description", ExpectedAnswers: []string{"answer"}}}}, nil
}

type checkpointStudent struct{}

func (checkpointStudent) ReserveOnboardingPathExecution(context.Context, domain.OnboardingPlanHandoffRecord, string, string) (domainservice.OnboardingPathAdmission, error) {
	return domainservice.OnboardingPathAdmission{}, errors.New("unused")
}
func (checkpointStudent) RenewOnboardingPathExecution(_ context.Context, _ domain.OnboardingPlanHandoffRecord, _ string, fence int64, _ string, _ string) (domainservice.OnboardingPathAdmission, error) {
	return domainservice.OnboardingPathAdmission{AdmissionID: "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555", Fence: fence + 1, ExpiresAt: time.Now().UTC().Add(time.Minute)}, nil
}
func (checkpointStudent) MaterializeOnboardingPathExecution(context.Context, domainservice.OnboardingPathMaterialization) (domainservice.OnboardingPathMaterialization, error) {
	return domainservice.OnboardingPathMaterialization{}, errors.New("unused")
}
func (checkpointStudent) AbortOnboardingPathExecution(context.Context, domain.OnboardingPlanHandoffRecord, string, int64, string, string, string) error {
	return errors.New("unused")
}

type checkpointClock struct{ now time.Time }

func (c checkpointClock) Now() time.Time { return c.now }

var _ courseplan.Clock = checkpointClock{}

func checkpointHandoff(now time.Time) domain.OnboardingPlanHandoffRecord {
	return domain.OnboardingPlanHandoffRecord{HandoffID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222", StudentID: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", IdempotencyKey: "66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666", RequestHash: "aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa", StateRef: domain.StudentReadinessStateRef{Kind: domain.StudentReadinessStateDraft, Version: 1}, DialogID: "77777777-7777-4777-8777-777777777777", TeacherJobID: "88888888-8888-4888-8888-888888888888", Goal: domain.LearningReadinessGoal{Code: "programming.foundation", Version: "v1", GraphVersion: "g"}, ReadinessObservedAt: now, CreatedAt: now}
}
func checkpointFrozen(t *testing.T) FrozenSnapshot {
	t.Helper()
	graph := domain.GoalGraph{Goal: domain.LearningGoal{Code: "programming.foundation", Version: "v1", GraphVersion: "g", Title: "Foundation"}, Targets: []domain.LearningTarget{{Ref: domain.TargetRef{Type: "concept", Key: "a", Version: "v1"}, Title: "A", ModuleCode: "m", ModuleTitle: "M", SectionCode: "s", SectionTitle: "S", LessonCode: "one", LessonTitle: "One"}, {Ref: domain.TargetRef{Type: "concept", Key: "b", Version: "v1"}, Title: "B", ModuleCode: "m", ModuleTitle: "M", SectionCode: "s", SectionTitle: "S", LessonCode: "two", LessonTitle: "Two", LessonOrder: 1}}}
	policy := domain.PolicyBundle{PlannerVersion: "p", PedagogyProfile: "p-v1", PresentationStyle: "s-v1", GenerationPolicy: "g-v1", PedagogyStrategies: []domain.PedagogyStrategyVersion{{Code: "explicit_instruction", Version: 1, Config: json.RawMessage(`{}`)}}}
	snapshot := domain.StudentPlanningReadinessSnapshot{Schema: domain.StudentReadinessSnapshotSchema, StudentID: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", StateRef: domain.StudentReadinessStateRef{Kind: domain.StudentReadinessStateDraft, Version: 1}, Profile: domain.StudentReadinessProfile{KnownStacks: domain.StudentReadinessStackValues{State: domain.StudentReadinessArrayUnanswered}, DesiredStacks: domain.StudentReadinessStackValues{State: domain.StudentReadinessArrayUnanswered}, PreferredLanguage: &domain.StudentReadinessLanguage{Code: "ru", Provenance: "explicit_ui"}, ContentLanguage: &domain.StudentReadinessLanguage{Code: "ru", Provenance: "explicit_ui", Source: "preferred_language"}}}
	frozen, _, err := BuildFrozenSnapshot(graph, policy, snapshot, pedagogy.NewDefaultRegistry())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return frozen
}
